events.text: GM tagged Linksanelf2006
Party stood on deck of vessel in morning fog for final briefing.
Warpriest Valerius Kael briefed party about shore of Isle of Nith.
Brother Elias introduced himself as lieutenant leading the party.
Bereket, Waldemar and Heron introduced themselves to Elias.
Elias laid out route across island and discussed formations.
Heron spotted figure running deeper into forest and party followed trail.
Party discussed seeing in dark and shared torches.
Heron raised shield and torch and moved forward into dark.
Ali and Waldemar noticed figure and Bereket saw trail and footprints.
Elias climbed down hole first and signaled it was clear.
Elias fell into spiked pit ahead in tunnel and died.
Party charged lit room and ambushed three cloaked individuals at table.
Party opened door and entered empty hallway with four doors.
Party sent owl message then breached door into small damp room.
Party left one cultist dead and one unconscious and bound him.
Waldemar smashed barricaded door revealing large cavern with dais and crystals.
Bereket shot arrows at eastern archer from walkway.
Heron taunted archer and advanced with raised shield.
Waldemar struck chanting cultist with empowered maul.
Ali killed shielded cultist and moved toward chanting cultists.
Lead cultist stabbed Waldemar as chanting continued.
Berekit downed the final archer and the wounded leader warned the ritual could not be stopped.
The lead cultist went down leaving only the chanting chorus.
The chanters stabbed themselves and their blood pooled in the floor glyphs.
A woman's voice said she was free as the party felt changed.
The woman left through the passageway and the stone sealed behind her.
The party heard a cry for help and moved toward it.
Shouting led the party to a locked door which Ali opened.
The party found a distressed elvish man inside.
The man said he was to be sacrificed and wanted to go home.
The man thanked the party and asked which way was out.
Waldemar handed the elf a cultist shortsword for protection.
The party found a dead dwarf in the spear trap and heard commotion from the entrance.
Ali heard outsiders arguing about entering because of traps.
Waldemar smelled various people of different races outside.
Berekit decided to clear the traps and meet the patrols at the entrance.
The party navigated the tunnel toward the entrance voices.
The party was lifted out of the entrance and surrounded by soldiers.
Waldemar reported the cultists succeeded in the ritual.
Berekit presented the kidnapped man and relayed the freed entity's message.
Silas Dimroot said the cultists intended to sacrifice him.
The party arrived by teleportation platform in the Domusirex military district.
Heron invited the party to a quiet tavern to agree on a story.
Heron pointed out The Garden View tavern ahead.
The party arrived at The Garden View and an elvish server seated them.
Heron questioned how wizards could change the entire world.
Berekit ordered ale and discussed remembering two worlds.
Ali said she died as a human child and a higher power revived her.
Waldemar said he was born human and cursed by cultists.
Waitress served ale and offered stew
Waitress shared gossip about the college and city guard
Heron questioned waitress about strange feelings and missing time
Waitress said she had never heard the tale of warring gods
Berekit suggested the library might hold answers
Heron spoke about needing coin for his sick mother
Party found a local inn and heard birds saying Come Follow
Berekit gathered his travel pack and agreed to follow the birds
Heron followed Berekit while still groggy
Birds led the group through the streets toward the college where fewer people remained
Berekit hoped for scribing supplies and wondered who sent the birds
Met amber-eyed woman in foliage dress who walked into empty college.
Chased child-form woman down hall after she asked to be caught.
Arrived in large room with stone arches and table and met old man.
Recounted mercenary mission against cult trying to summon Nith M'aera.
Received owl figurines and task to go to three marked locations.
Watched old man leave through portal after ordering Atrix to prepare party.
Followed Atrix through halls and out of college while building bustled.
Met dwarf companion Varalia and received vision through green light.
Berekit introduced himself to dwarf and offered time for questions.
Learned from Atrix that party would have time and resources for supplies.
Varalia apologized for a mistaken sense and planted a seed and chanted over it.
Varalia learned the swamp had expanded, engulfed a village, and held rumors of dangerous creatures and a hag.
Varalia told the party about the dangers and offered help treating diseases and wounds.
Captain Valerius said reports were thorough enough and a goblin removed symbols from hands.
The captain freed the party and Atrix waited outside the barracks entrance.
Heron agreed to take leave and asked Berekit if they were ready.
Berekit said he copied a scroll and was ready to head out.
Atrix led the party out through the southern gate and changed back to her earlier form.
Atrix introduced Leaf as an aid imbued with grace.
Heron discovered his coin pouch was not where he had placed it.
The party heard a jingling sound coming from Leaf.
Atrix said Leaf had direction sense, then crumbled into leaves and blew away.
Berekit thanked Atrix and said Leaf would help with small spaces.
The party traveled south for days to Wanhoop Swamp and heard a village lay nearby.
Leaf stabbed the cockatrice twice and brought it down.
The party recognized the creature as a larger-than-normal cockatrice that could petrify.
Leaf treated Heron and restored health.
Leaf guided the party to a damaged and nearly deserted village.
The party noticed something small with a large head dart behind a building.
The party entered the inn and met the dwarven innkeeper.
Quacksalver greeted the travelers and asked about the marshlands.
Quacksalver drank a mutagen and showed its effects were temporary.
The innkeeper broke a broom and complained it was the second that month.
The innkeeper said damage had increased about two weeks ago.
Berekit cast detect magic before moving off.

time_cues: That's the second one this month!

events.text: Berekit noticed faint magic on various broken items.
Party rested for the evening and found gear damaged in the morning.
Leaf rounded the corner jingling and answered inquisitively.
Heron claimed Leaf was created by a god to guide them.
Leaf walked out the door, looked around and pointed right.
Berekit noticed two tiny creatures diving behind a bush.
Party learned the creatures were small bipeds with disproportionately large heads.
Party recognized the creatures as Jinkins able to curse objects as a group.
Berekit offered to track the Jinkins to a nearby warren.
Party followed the trail to an abandoned home and faced expected battle.
Jinkins swarmed Leaf, Quacksalver and Heron and inflicted damage.
Leaf stabbed two Jinkins and killed them.
Leaf finished the remaining Jinkin and ended combat.
A villager shouted asking what the creatures were.
The innkeeper gave directions to Lady Inda deeper in the swamp.
The innkeeper led the party to a kitsune finishing a transaction.
Húxiān introduced herself as recent inheritor of an ancient lineage.
Húxiān collected supplies from the roadside stall and agreed to help.
Quacksalver explained gremlins had cursed their important gear.
Húxiān said her mother knew about curses.
Party carried items out of town and reached a run-down cabin.
Lady Inda sharply said they were late.
Lady Inda invited the party inside but told Berekit to use a window.
Lady Inda served stew to Húxiān and yelled at Leaf for examining the pot.
Lady Inda stopped yelling and tilted her head at Leaf.
Quacksalver gestured and kept walking toward the pull.
The party traveled south for days and spotted a smoking village on the horizon.
Heron urged haste to help possible survivors.
Berekit advised approaching to observe first.
Quacksalver continued toward the village without sneaking.

time_cues: the morning of the eighth day since leaving the swamp

events.text: The party arrived at a burning village and found orcs killing villagers.
The party defeated the orcs and ended combat.
Huxian and Berekit found a living infant and a hiding halfling.
The halfling gave his name as Wrenwick Willowberry.
Wrenwick moved villager bodies to a field while the orc revealed raiders heading southeast.
The party rested at the southern edge and spotted a distant white plume to the southeast.

time_cues: In the morning, shortly before dawn's first light

events.text: The party arrived at a small village of clustered buildings and planted trees.
A human child shouted at Berekit and drew the villagers attention.
Heron warned an old man and Dura that Buros raiders were a day or two away.
Dura left to have villagers pack their belongings.
Heron asked about Gremm and challenging him to a duel.
The old man led the party inside his home and discussed Gremm and boats.
Heron asked the old man to send warnings to nearby villages.
The old man quieted the panicking villagers outside.
The old man spread a village map to plan the defense.
Dura reported that Thomas was leading villagers to the cave.
Chase called the plan complicated, asked if raids happened seasonally, and rolled something to smoke.
The old man told the party to run if things went wrong and said destroying the building at the right time could cut the raider numbers.
Quacksalver rigged the home to explode and set up barricades, while Húxiān and Heron organized villagers for the oil trap and ambushes.
Chase dosed up the party and readied his bow for a long-range engagement against the orcs.
An empty message was posted
